document.author.description: Row of the properties block of a document page: the author the file states.

document.convertedNote.defaultMessage: Converted at publication, cached by fingerprint
document.convertedNote.description: Note under the rendered page of a document: how the preview was produced.

document.date.description: Row of the properties block of a document page: the date the file states.

document.dateNote.defaultMessage: Read from the file, distinct from the repository date.
document.dateNote.description: Note under the properties of a document page, when they were read from the file.

document.download.description: Link to the original file of a converted document.

document.extractedText.description: Tab of a document page showing the text extracted from the file.

document.extractedTextOf.defaultMessage: Extracted text — {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
document.extractedTextOf.description: Heading of the extracted text of a document whose conversion failed, with its number of pages.

document.groupedNote.defaultMessage: Grouped by folder, date and textual overlap — a single entry in the index.
document.groupedNote.description: Note under the files of a document page: why they form one page.

document.indexedNote.description: Note at the head of the extracted text of a document whose conversion failed.

document.kind.pdf.description: Kind of a document whose file is a PDF.

document.kind.presentation.description: Kind of a document whose file is a slide deck.

document.kind.spreadsheet.description: Kind of a document whose file is a spreadsheet.

document.kind.text.description: Kind of a document whose file is a word-processing document.

document.noNote.defaultMessage: No note describes this document yet.
document.noNote.description: Notes tab of a document page when no note is merged with the document.

document.openPdf.description: Link to the PDF of a document, offered where the page cannot show it.

document.originalNote.description: Note under the rendered page of a document: the original file is still offered.

document.pageCount.description: Heading of the strip of pages and row of the properties block of a document page.

document.pages.description: Number of pages of a converted document.

document.preview.description: Link to the rendered preview of a converted document.

document.previewFailed.defaultMessage: The preview of this document could not be generated.
document.previewFailed.description: Title of the notice on a document page whose conversion failed.

document.previewNote.defaultMessage: Size and page count of the PDF preview, the original stating none.
document.previewNote.description: Note under the properties of a document page when the size or the page count was read from the PDF preview rather than from the original file.

document.relatedNote.defaultMessage: A document does not enter the model: its pages bring passages, and the note that describes it stands among its files.
document.relatedNote.description: Note under the related pages of a document page, saying that the document itself is not a note of the model.

document.relatedNotes.description: Tab of a document page showing the note merged with the document.

document.reportedNote.defaultMessage: The same finding stands in the publication report and in the linter output: the failure is reported to whoever can fix it.
document.reportedNote.description: Note under the state of the representations of a document whose conversion failed.

document.representations.description: Heading of the panel listing the representations of a document and the state of each.

document.roleNotes.description: Role of the note among the files of a document page.

document.roleOriginal.description: Role of the original file among the files of a document page.

document.rolePreview.description: Role of the PDF among the files of a document page.

document.sameDocument.defaultMessage: Same document, {count, plural, one {one file} other {# files}}
document.sameDocument.description: Heading of the block listing the files that make one document page.

document.stateAvailable.description: State of the original file in the panel of the representations.

document.stateExtracted.description: State of the text in the panel of the representations when it was read.

document.stateFailed.description: State of the preview in the panel of the representations when the conversion failed.

document.stateMissing.description: State of the text in the panel of the representations when nothing was read.

document.textExtracted.defaultMessage: The text was extracted all the same: it is indexed, cited on the other pages, and readable below.
document.textExtracted.description: Sentence of the notice on a document page whose conversion failed, when the text of the document was read.

document.textMissing.defaultMessage: Its text could not be extracted either: the original stays downloadable, and the note that describes it stands among its files.
document.textMissing.description: Sentence of the notice on a document page whose conversion failed, when no text of the document was read.

document.textRepresentation.description: Row of the text in the panel of the representations.

document.type.description: Row of the properties block of a document page: the kind of the file.

document.view.description: Tab of a document page showing the rendered document.

document.views.description: Accessible name of the tab bar of a document page.

document.whyFailed.description: Control of the notice on a document page whose conversion failed, unfolding the finding the build recorded.
